column1: # Device: Orin. Shared native host contract: Ubuntu 22.04 (Jammy), arm64,
# ROS 2 Humble. This is a target-device runtime/build-library manifest, not
# a system-image or Debian-builder manifest. Ubuntu supplies libc, PAM,
# systemd, GCC, curl, APT and networking; never carry those packages here.
# Debian/ROS package-generator tools belong on the dedicated build machine.
# Other ROS feature dependencies are delivered by their owning module.
